def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for top in range(h):
        for left in range(w):
            color = grid[top][left]
            # Grow a rectangle row by row, maintaining the contiguous
            # same-color run that starts at left.
            right = left
            for bottom in range(top, h):
                if grid[bottom][left] != color:
                    break
                c = left
                while c < w and grid[bottom][c] == color:
                    c += 1
                right = min(right, c - 1) if bottom > top else c - 1
                height = bottom - top + 1
                width = right - left + 1

                if (height >= 5 and width >= 5) or (height == 2 and width == 3):
                    # Only paint maximal rectangles, avoiding accidental
                    # subrectangles of a larger uniform patch.
                    extend_left = left > 0 and all(
                        grid[r][left - 1] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1))
                    extend_right = right + 1 < w and all(
                        grid[r][right + 1] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1))
                    extend_up = top > 0 and all(
                        grid[top - 1][c] == color for c in range(left, right + 1))
                    extend_down = bottom + 1 < h and all(
                        grid[bottom + 1][c] == color for c in range(left, right + 1))
                    if not (extend_left or extend_right or extend_up or extend_down):
                        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
                            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
